notes.title: Autumn Update with discounts!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey gang!

This autumn, our girl finally made it to The Mosquito Gang party—and she brought a game discount with her!
Everyone, welcome our new female character! Don’t let her beautiful eyes fool you—she can destroy mosquitoes just as well as our fellow male character!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44896781/3adf51a0b94f219a48d189a78144fb262600aa65.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]👩 New Female Character[/h2][list][*][p] Added female character[/p][/*][*][p] Adjusted headwear for female character[/p][/*][*][p] Added cosmetic items for female character[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]💸 Steam game Discount[/h2][p]The 25% discount period starts today 29.08.2025 at 15:00 CET and will continue until 12.09.2025.
So if you have friends who were waiting to grab the game at a reduced price—now’s the time!

And here are some additional updates:

[/p][h2]🦟 Infestation Mode[/h2][list][*][p] New mosquito “Golden Snitch,” which gives a cash reward upon death[/p][/*][*][p] Added a cash reward for discarding a used electric flyswatter[/p][/*][*][p] Added a cash reward for discarding a used RPG[/p][/*][*][p] Added a cash reward for discarding a used machine gun[/p][/*][*][p] Increased flamethrower damage from 8 to 12[/p][/*][*][p] Human respawn in this mode now occurs at the starting position instead of the place of death[/p][/*][*][p] Added new weapon “Puncher”

notes.title: Summer Update: New Mode, Map, Outfits & Rewards!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey gang!

Our Huge Update launches as we join the Steam Summer Sale!
Every player who logs into the game during the Steam Summer Sale will receive Human summer outfit.

What’s in the Update?
Here’s the list:

[/p][h2]🦟 New Game Mode: Mosquito Infestation 🦟[/h2][p]Up to four Human players fight HUGE swarms of Mosquitoes.
Try to survive 10 waves to win the game!
Use new weapons to fight back:
[/p][olist][*][p]Nerf Heavy Machine Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Toy Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Flamethrower (this one is not homemade)[/p][/*][*][p]Turbo Smoke Spiral[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Sniper Fumigator[/p][/*][/olist][p]
In future updates, we’ll provide additional options for this game mode, including difficulty scaling for single-player, and a friendly fire switch to take the challenge to another level.

[/p][h2]New Map: Polygon[/h2][p]We saw a lot of feedback regarding the difficulty of our mini games. So, we created a map for you to launch in single player and try everything the game offers: quest mini games, human devices, or mosquito abilities. [/p][p][/p][h2]🧍 Human[/h2][list][*][p]Human health points are now shown as numbers, not percentages.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new weapon to the Human shop – Toy Pistol.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual effects to spiral and fumigator poison damage on Mosquitoes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual indication for low health.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Yellow Suit outfit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Beach outfit.
 [/p][/*][/list][h2]🦟 Mosquito[/h2][list][*][p]Added new Gardener ability: spawn grass on any flat surface to provide a reliable hiding place for the entire team.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Speed Flag ability: all mosquitoes within the radius have increased speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Speed Flag ability upgrade – Totem of Torture: your flag also emits mosquito buzzing to confuse Humans.[/p][/*][*][p]Speed Flag ability upgrade – Scarecrow: your flag creates fake mosquitoes that are visible in AR glasses.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield ability upgrade – The Dome: now you can cover your entire team with a shield.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Shark outfit.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Balance Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the feedback, swarm!

Over the past three days, we've been hard at work addressing your comments on balance, bugs, and overall gameplay issues. Your support and detailed reports helped us pinpoint the key areas for improvement. This update brings targeted changes to both factions, improves overall quality of life, and fixes some long-standing technical issues.

We’ve made mosquitoes stronger, humans a bit more fair, and the game as a whole more enjoyable to play — whether you’re biting or blasting.

Here’s what’s new:

Mosquito Balance Changes 
- Base stamina increased to 80
- Number of lives per mosquito increased to 4
- Dash ability is no longer removed when using teleport
- Changed the color of the Astral buff for mosquitoes
- Improved QTE behavior for mosquitoes
- Added more mosquito hiding spots on the third map



Human Balance Adjustments 
- RPG price increased to 120
- Maximum RPG count reduced to 2
- Maximum number of boxing gloves reduced to 1
- Defensive spray charge reduced by 20%
- Added a delay to the door on the second map to block human abuse
- Switch of camera to third person camera while emoting



Gameplay & Quality of Life 
- Added FOV setting
- Added game version check
- Removed overflow on flowers
- QTE no longer resets due to small intersections
- Fixed bug where escape point wasn’t visible after respawn from Astral
- Added visual indicators for: casino, music player, laptop, and human quests
- Updated the model of the electric fly swatter
- Fixed music player bug on preset 2 of the first map


Progression & Rewards 
- Defeat now grants 100 XP instead of 50 XP


Other Fixes
- Fixed issues in Portuguese localization
- Fixed crash on first launch for some players

notes.title: Important Update for Closed Beta Test
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have some key updates to share with you.

Firstly, we're beyond grateful to see so many of you diving into our Closed Beta Test – your support and dedication mean the world to us. We’re lucky to have such a passionate community, and we thank each of you for joining us on this journey!

That said, we’ve encountered some issues that require us to adjust the Beta Test schedule. To address these, access to the game will be temporarily paused starting today at 20:00 GMT+3. Please rest assured that we’re working hard to resolve everything and get back on track as soon as possible!

Planned Reopening
We’re aiming to resume access this Saturday. Although it’ll be just after Halloween, we’ll still be offering our Halloween-themed character cosmetics so you can enjoy them during the playtest.

Once again, from everyone at Space Raccoon, THANK YOU for being a part of this exciting journey. We can’t wait to jump back into the game with you all very soon!
